units.source_text: 此外还有妓女、女演员、女贩等混杂其中。

en.t: In addition, courtesans, actresses, female vendors, and others were mixed in among them.

units.source_text: 以上列举了女子，当然还有像楠正成、织田信长、丰臣秀吉、王朝公卿和武将。

en.t: The examples above were women, but of course there were also figures such as Kusunoki Masashige, Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, court nobles of the imperial age, and military commanders.
